title: Bills print report & exports 10/10
summary: Print report is now a proper A4/PDF sales summary for the selected date range (not a tiny thermal slip). Excel remains the full data export; CSV is grouped as a secondary option.
highlights: Print report: A4 layout, period + filter label, KPIs, payment breakdown, tax, refunds, bill list.
Title matches range (Today / Yesterday / 7 days / All / Custom) — no more always-Daily.
Export group: Excel (recommended) + CSV side by side; Print report for paper/PDF close.
Report uses active Bills filters and tax label from settings when available.
